headline: Subscription and credit pricing transparency is the single largest fixable drag on the rating.

themes.summary: Several users report crashes, freezing, endless loading screens, and the app failing to complete tasks, sometimes even consuming credits during these failures.
themes.action: Prioritize fixing crash and freeze bugs, especially those that consume user credits during failures.

themes.summary: Customers frequently complain about confusing credit consumption, expensive or opaque subscription pricing, paywalls appearing early, and difficulty cancelling subscriptions, while some ask for more generous free plans.
themes.action: Improve transparency around credit costs and subscription terms, and simplify the cancellation process.

themes.summary: Users describe how well Lovable turns ideas into working websites and apps, praising speed, ease of use, and output quality, with some noting inconsistent results or bugs it introduces.
themes.action: Invest in improving consistency of AI-generated output and reduce the number of iterations needed to get accurate results.

themes.summary: Many users give brief, general praise or criticism about the app without referencing a specific feature, ranging from 'love it' and 'best app' to 'worst' and 'didn't work'.
themes.action: Continue monitoring general sentiment trends over time as a health metric, but rely on feature-specific topics for actionable product changes.

themes.summary: A few users report being unable to log in or get past the home screen, including errors when signing in with Google.
themes.action: Investigate and resolve authentication error codes and Google sign-in flow issues.

themes.summary: Some users are frustrated that the AI makes unrequested project changes or continues actions after being told to stop, leading to wasted credits and a feeling of being overridden.
themes.action: Add stronger user controls to halt AI actions immediately and prevent unsolicited modifications to projects.

themes.theme: Mobile app vs. website feature parity
themes.summary: Users note that the mobile app is convenient for working on the go but is glitchy and lacks many features available on the full website version.
themes.action: Align mobile app functionality and stability with the web platform to close the feature gap.

caveats: Sentences from the same verbatim are not independent observations; clustering inflates apparent significance.
Themes can overlap (a verbatim may belong to several), so groups aren't mutually exclusive as most tests assume.
Sentiment scores are LLM judgments, not a validated instrument; treat them as a consistent proxy, not ground truth.
Source data is a convenience sample (whoever chose to post), not a random sample of customers.
7 themes tested; Bonferroni correction applied, which is conservative and may hide real effects.

summary.headline: Subscription and credit pricing transparency is the single largest fixable drag on the rating.
key_findings: Pricing and subscription friction is a real, sizable problem: 13 mentions, sentiment -0.249, rating impact -0.209, statistically significant with a large effect.
App stability issues carry a similar per-review cost: 8 mentions, sentiment -0.239, rating impact -0.223, significant and large, concentrated on App Store.

The product's core strengths are worth protecting: AI-powered building (27 mentions, sentiment 0.59, impact +0.275) and overall app experience (34 mentions, sentiment 0.612, impact +0.301, concentrated on Google Play) are the two strongest positive drivers.
Login access and AI autonomy complaints are flagged but thin: 2 and 3 mentions respectively, too little volume to act on with confidence.

nextSteps.title: Prioritize fixing crash and freeze bugs, especially those that consume user credits during failures.
nextSteps.rationale: 8 mentions with sentiment -0.239 and a significant, large rating impact of -0.223, concentrated on App Store, mark this as a genuine but limited-volume issue worth investigating.

nextSteps.title: Improve transparency around credit costs and subscription terms, and simplify the cancellation process.
nextSteps.rationale: 13 mentions with sentiment -0.249 and a significant, large rating impact of -0.209 make this the highest-volume negative theme flagged for investigation.
